explanation: No source contract certifying complete transaction history was supplied. The last organic_preperiod event on 2025-01-09 is an observed transaction timestamp, not a verified coverage watermark. Campaign-attributed orders do not certify coverage of ordinary purchases. Consequently, recent observed counts may be zero while complete recent purchase history remains unknown.

interval_contract.scope: Only all_sources intervals can certify complete purchase history.
interval_contract.start: Inclusive beginning of the explicitly certified transaction interval.
interval_contract.end: End of the interval; exclusive unless end_inclusive is true.
interval_contract.available_as_of: Timestamp when this certification was known; must be at or before the decision cutoff.
interval_contract.customer_ids: Optional nonempty list of customer IDs; null or omitted applies globally.

reference_window.interpretation: Optional observed historical baseline shared across cohorts, not a correction to the decision-relative 90-day window and not a claim of complete coverage.
